description: A two-storey side extension incorporating a garage conversion, adding a new office and extra bedroom space to a home in Hertford.
note: Confirmed by the user as a two-storey side extension with garage conversion, likely completed in 2019. Local authority is East Hertfordshire District Council (confirmed from the postcode, SG13). Planning type confirmed as Full Planning, as a two-storey side extension of this kind would not qualify as permitted development; no decision notice survives in the archive to confirm the application reference or exact date.

caseStudy.text: Mr Moore wanted a substantial two-storey side extension for his home at 17 Martins Drive, Hertford, making better use of the existing garage and roof space at the same time.
caseStudy.heading: The Brief

caseStudy.text: Architecture ONE's drawings show a two-storey side extension incorporating the existing garage, with a new office added at ground floor and the roof void converted into additional first-floor bedroom space.
caseStudy.heading: The Approach

caseStudy.text: Drawings for both the existing and proposed layouts were prepared (job ref. 2019/046); the project is understood to have run into 2019.
caseStudy.heading: The Outcome
